text:
miranda: FYI during vuln triage we flagged openssl CVE-2026-189 and a followup weak-cipher build in the baseimage. Need coordinated rebuild + cosign signing + RBAC for keystore operator. Trying to minimize prod exposure.
omar: Suggest flow: 1) rebuild baseimage in staging, 2) attach SBOM and attestation, 3) sign with cosign via keystore operator, 4) deploy a small prod canary.
kevin: Oncall available for canary window tomorrow 1400-1600 UTC. What RBAC grants does keystore-operator need precisely?
miranda: keystore-operator needs the following: kms.keys.decrypt, kms.keys.decryptUsingMac (GCP style), and iam.serviceAccounts.actAs to allow cosign agent to use the signer SA. We'll create a scoped role `roles/keystore.signer` bound to infra-signing:image-signer.
tess: Compliance wants audit retention for any key unwrap events bumped to 180d for this rollout. Also want SBOM attachment events logged to `audit.images.sbom`.
omar: Storage estimate: SBOMs ~ 15KB each, attestations 2KB, signing metadata 4KB. For ~150k images across pipelines expect ~2.7GB extra. Flagging cost center infra-signing.
kevin: How will the rollout handle unverified images? fallback policy?
miranda: Fallback: builders will push to `staging/unsigned/` if signing fails. A CI gate will reject promotion to `prod` without a `cosign` signature. Emergency bypass only via infra-ops with an audited ticket.
omar: RBAC patch we'll apply to staging first. Kubectl apply snippet: 
```\napiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1\nkind: RoleBinding\nmetadata:\n  name: keystore-image-signer-staging\n  namespace: infra-signing\nsubjects:\n- kind: ServiceAccount\n  name: image-signer\n  namespace: infra-signing\nroleRef:\n  kind: Role\n  name: keystore-signer-role\n  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io\n```
kevin: Good — please gate that with a short review in infra-signing team. Also add an IAM policy binding in GCP console for the signer SA.
tess: I'll update the incident runbook: include RBAC snippet, SBOM retention numbers, alert thresholds (signing-failures > 10 in 5m -> pager). Assign to me for runbook PR.
kms-bot: key-access-log: projects/redwood-kms/locations/global/keyRings/signers/cryptoKeys/signer-02 used by serviceAccount:image-signer@infra-signing at 2026-03-17T18:02:11Z
ci-bot: dev-pipeline: baseimage rebuild triggered (build-8842). SBOM attached: sbom://build-8842/sha256:8b5a...
omar: Can we add a policy-engine verify step before pushing to prod repo? e.g., `policy-eval` check for SBOM and signature.
miranda: Yes — we'll add `policy-eval` in the promote pipeline. If policy-eval fails, artifact goes to `staging/quarantine` and security team gets a ticket.
kevin: Monitoring: make sure Splunk index `k8s.audit.keystore` and `audit.images.sbom` are included. I'll add dashboards for signature rate and key unwrap errors.
tess: PR opened for runbook and alerting: https://git.redwood/infrasec/repo/pull/421 
omar: Deployment plan: night window low-traffic 02:00 UTC Friday for prod RBAC, with a 30m canary, then 2h ramp. If any `signing_failure` alerts or key unwrap errors > 1% of requests, roll back RBAC by removing the binding and pause the pipeline.
miranda: One more item: we need a short `cosign verify` step in smoke tests. Snippet: `cosign verify --key ksm://projects/redwood-kms/locations/global/keyRings/signers/cryptoKeys/signer-02 baseimage:stable`
ci-bot: smoke job queued: smoke-212 on canary pool.
kevin: I'll watch the pager. Tag me if prod alerts cross thresholds. :thumbsup: 
tess: Notifying compliance and support: filed ticket COMP-587 with retention change request.
omar: Thanks all, will follow up with the RBAC Terraform change and IAM binding.
